calendarFaqs.q: When did Fort Wayne Community Schools start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The districtwide first student day was August 7, 2025. Grades 6 and 9 had Transition Day July 29, kindergarten had Transition Day August 1, and Pre-K started August 21.

calendarFaqs.q: When did FWCS students return after Winter Vacation?
calendarFaqs.a: Students returned Tuesday, January 6, 2026. Monday, January 5 was a teacher professional-learning and work day with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: Was October 31, 2025 a student attendance day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. FWCS labeled October 31 a Release Day for parent-teacher conferences, and the calendar marks no student attendance.

calendarFaqs.q: Which weather schedule changes appear on the 2025–26 FWCS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The archived calendar records eLearning or virtual learning on December 1, January 23, January 27, and January 28; a district weather closing January 26; and two-hour delays March 5–6.
FWCS listed graduation ceremonies for May 29 and May 30, 2026. Families should use school-specific records for ceremony assignments and times.
